review_type: Independent source/math review and targeted pre-fix counterexamples; no CPU benchmark by this reviewer
checkout_scope: Verified selected source reconstruction, not a complete repository checkout or production build

mathematical_findings.result: No new normal-domain first-passage/reset joint-state error identified in the inspected R14 path
mathematical_findings.reason: R12 carries phase/content joint CTMC state; natural absorption and recovery are inside Q; R14 external-sensor RESET uses R before the full elapsed transition. Counts and first-event probability have different marked/killed operators.

mathematical_findings.result: Equivalent objective in exact arithmetic for nonnegative masses and conservative transitions
mathematical_findings.reason: Unnormalized mass recursion preserves terminal linear rewards, end-state READ costs, public elapsed costs, reset-before-propagation and sums of observation-branch optimal values. Future values use raw max; the deployed first action retains the inherited sequential tolerance rule.

mathematical_findings.result: Applies identically to ordinary and HX estimators
mathematical_findings.reason: The accelerator consumes the same frozen Q,E,R,reward/read-cost model and causal belief. It supplies no extra observation or latent state and cannot establish an HX-exclusive mechanism gain.

Matrix exponentials and planner recursion refer to the specified finite model. Neither eight active bins nor Erlang recovery becomes an exact continuous diffusion or fixed refractory interval through this optimization.

reproduced_defects_and_current_review.fix_review: Checked transition rejects nonfinite exponentials; checked action-value output also rejects nonfinite results.
Current CheckedBeliefDP wraps action_values, evaluate_policy and paired_q_pi with numerical-error handling and finite-result checks.

reproduced_defects_and_current_review.counterexample: Subclass legal_actions removes RESET; original channels(prior,(0.2,),0) subtracts None from a float and raises TypeError.
reproduced_defects_and_current_review.fix_review: Current channels returns B=None and advantage=None, does not claim reset optimality, and respects the subclass action restriction.
Current channels calls self.choose, so diagnostic action and actual guarded action share the same selector.

tie_rule.original_rule: Visit STOP0, STOP1, WAIT, READ, RESET in order and replace the current choice only when q_new > q_current + 1e-12.
tie_rule.current_review: Preserved. Internal value maximization remains ordinary max, not the value of the epsilon-selected action.

limits: This heuristic does not prove action equivalence for every finite IEEE input.
Actual-policy equality must be established on the retained replay prefixes; no inference from small mean Q error alone.

Long-horizon fallback uses the original outer recursion, whose short suffixes may still use batching; it preserves the mathematical objective but is not a claim that every operation is reference-only.

validation.reviewer_initial_seven_methods: Passed after correcting the test callback to WAIT when a forced READ exhausted its remaining budget.
validation.reviewer_eighth_regression: Added channels/choose boundary consistency witness after independently reproducing the discrepancy.
validation.final_eight_methods: Parent reports all eight pass after the current fixes; final suite not rerun by this reviewer during the serial timing campaign.
validation.independent_cost_witness: RESET -> WAIT -> READ with exact sensor repair/reveal yields utility 0.903 after all elapsed time, repair fee and multiplied end-state READ fee.

scientific_acceptance.interpretation: Replay of already opened episodes is a numerical/implementation-cost equivalence study. It cannot overturn failed R14 science gates or create a new independent confirmation sample.

overall: Mathematical design and targeted interface fixes are consistent with the stated finite-model scope. Performance and complete replay equality are left to the root serial campaign; the heuristic fallback is explicitly not a global numerical certificate.
